There is no past history of any specific medical disorder. His father died of lung cancer at the age of 54 years. Which of the following is the best next step in management?

original_controller_query: A square has a perimeter of $28 \text{ cm}.$ What is the area of the square, in $\mbox{cm}^2?$

documents.question: A square has a perimeter of $28 \text{ cm}.$ What is the area of the square, in $\mbox{cm}^2?$
documents.solution: Since the four sides of a square are equal in length and the perimeter is $28,$ then each side has length $\frac{28}{4}=7.$  The area of the square is the product of the length and width, which are each equal to $7.$ Therefore, the area of the square in $\mbox{cm}^2$ is $7\times7=\boxed{49}.$

original_controller_query: A square has a perimeter of $28 \text{ cm}.$ What is the area of the square, in $\mbox{cm}^2?$

documents.question: A square has a perimeter of $28 \text{ cm}.$ What is the area of the square, in $\mbox{cm}^2?$
documents.solution: Since the four sides of a square are equal in length and the perimeter is $28,$ then each side has length $\frac{28}{4}=7.$  The area of the square is the product of the length and width, which are each equal to $7.$ Therefore, the area of the square in $\mbox{cm}^2$ is $7\times7=\boxed{49}.$

documents.question: Compute $\left(\sqrt{625681}\right)^2$.
documents.solution: For any nonnegative number $n$, the value of $\sqrt{n}$ is the number whose square is $n$.  So, when we square $\sqrt{n}$, we get $n$.  Therefore, $\left(\sqrt{625681}\right)^2 = \boxed{625681}$.
